answer: New identities must post collateral that is slashed to its nadir, near zero, if their attestations conflict with peers, so forging many identities costs real capital per key while honest agents recover their stake. To resist sybils, bind each agent to a unique hardware jade token whose private key signs every epoch claim, and require a bonded stake locked in a shared vault. This makes mass identity creation economically irrational rather than merely inconvenient. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
